messages.author: b7a6b254b3e52274
messages.subject: How are active hours counted?
parts: I just got an email saying my app has used 25.1 active hours (which exceeds the free limit of 25 hours). However, the "application usage" panel shows 136.26 hours has been used. What's the deal with this inconsistency? Do I need to purchase the starter package (100 hours) or the basic package (500 hours) to prevent my app from being shut down?

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: How are active hours counted?
parts:
Without your account name and the id of the application, we cannot investigate the discrepancy.

That said, the Free and Starter tiers will give a grace period before suspending the account's applications until the start of the next cycle of hours. If you have applications that consume more than the tiers included hours and you wish for the application to not be suspended, then yes, you would need to upgrade to a tier with more hours.
